company.name: Striga
company.shortDescription: Regulated payments infrastructure for custody, trading, banking and card issuing
company.description:
Striga enables companies to embed compliant payment rails within their application without doing any of the heavy lifting related to MiCA licensing, EMI licensing etc. 

Made by developers, for developers, Striga is a set of powerful APIs to easily access compliant user onboarding, custody, trading, IBAN issuing and card issuing for 30+ countries in the European Union.

productsAndServices.description: APIs providing European bank accounts, SEPA payments, virtual IBANs, and card issuing for neobanks and fintechs without requiring licenses.
productsAndServices.name: Banking as a Service APIs

productsAndServices.description: Services for holding and safeguarding Bitcoin and stablecoins with individual deposit addresses compliant with European regulations.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Custody Services

productsAndServices.description: API-driven platform to issue and manage virtual and physical debit cards linked to Bitcoin and stablecoin balances, supporting consumer and corporate use cases.
productsAndServices.name: Card Issuing Platform

productsAndServices.description: APIs enabling real-time global payments using Bitcoin and stablecoins with SEPA Instant and open banking connectivity.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Payment API for Cross Border Payouts

productsAndServices.description: A compliance service offering crypto transaction monitoring, AML, and fraud detection integrated into onboarding and custody solutions.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Monitoring as a Service

productsAndServices.description: APIs to enable fiat-to-crypto on-ramping and crypto-to-fiat off-ramping within applications without leaving the user interface.
productsAndServices.name: Ramp Crypto with Single Set of APIs
